name: The Prophecy of All Hallows' Eve
source:
It's All Hallows' Eve, which also happens to be your birthday! In your town, there's a prophecy about someone born on this day 17 years ago who will defeat the Shadow King. Will it be you?

[From [url=https://juniorthedog.itch.io/the-prophecy-of-all-hallows-eve-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是万圣节前夕，也恰好是你的生日！在你的城镇里，有一个关于17年前的这一天出生的人的预言，他将击败暗影之王。会是你吗？

[来自[url=https://juniorthedog.itch.io/the-prophecy-of-all-hallows-eve-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
